args.description: Game skill effect sprite, side view: a crossbow bolt shot: a short heavy wooden crossbow bolt with an iron tip flying to the right, a pale streak of air behind it, and at the right end a small impact burst of amber sparks and wood splinters where it hits. Calm version: small and simple, few particles, a beginner skill. Detailed 16-bit pixel art in the same art style and palette mood as the style image: solid parts (wood, leather, cloth, rope, dust puffs, pebbles) have bold dark outlines and 3-4 step shading; glowing parts are bright with a hot near-white core fading to saturated color, crisp stepped pixel edges, no blur, no thin single-pixel line art. Only the effect: no characters, no people, no creatures, no hands, no text, transparent background.
